scenarios.option_label: Option A — Cascading Rooftop Unit Failure
scenarios.prompt: We have an active alarm storm on Floor 1 East Wing with multiple VAVs reporting high supply air temperature and warm space temperatures. Diagnose the true root cause, suppress sympathetic alarms, and stage a safe BACnet mitigation.

scenarios.option_label: BACnet MS/TP Trunk 2 Token Drop & Controller Fault
scenarios.prompt: Seven VAV boxes (VAV-2-109 through VAV-2-115) just went unresponsive simultaneously. Before dispatching HVAC technicians for 7 mechanical failures, verify whether this is a BACnet network transport issue.

scenarios.option_label: Silent Simultaneous Heating & Cooling Energy Waste
scenarios.prompt: Run a peer-cohort anomaly audit across the Floor 1 VAV boxes to check if any unit is fighting itself with simultaneous heating and cooling despite zero active BAS alarms.

scenarios.option_label: Option B — Critical Server Room Predictive Alert
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate the predictive thermal trajectory for Critical Server Room (bldg:zone_server_room) and its dedicated cooling unit (bldg:cooling_only_rtu_2). Can we prevent a 78.0°F thermal shutdown before the hard high-temp threshold trips?
